/*

	    bit     description

	    PB0     ROW0, JOY A0
	    PB1     ROW1, JOY A1
	    PB2     ROW2, JOY A2
	    PB3     ROW3, JOY A3
	    PB4     ROW4, BTNA, _LP
	    PB5     ROW5
	    PB6     ROW6
	    PB7     ROW7

	*/
	vcs_control_port_device *cur1 = m_portswap->read() ? m_joy2 : m_joy1;

	cur1->joy_w(data & 0x1f);

	m_vic->lp_w(BIT(data, 4));
return m_user_pb;
m_cass_rd = state; update_cia1_flag();
m_cia1->flag_w(m_cass_rd & m_iec_srq);
m_iec_srq = state; update_cia1_flag();
if (state) m_user_pb |= 1; else m_user_pb &= ~1;
if (state) m_user_pb |= 2; else m_user_pb &= ~2;
if (state) m_user_pb |= 4; else m_user_pb &= ~4;
if (state) m_user_pb |= 8; else m_user_pb &= ~8;
if (state) m_user_pb |= 16; else m_user_pb &= ~16;
if (state) m_user_pb |= 32; else m_user_pb &= ~32;

m_user_pa2 = state;
